description:
Use this when the user wants to know if a post is blowing up: "is anything taking off", "did my last clip
        pop", "is my TikTok going viral". Lists posts less than 48 hours old with at least 100 views and at least twice
        the views the user's other posts had at the same age (the rule behind the Taking off badge in RipClip), with
        the numbers. An empty list is a normal answer. Takes no parameters.
        Not for: a recap (weekly_report), one post's numbers (get_post_stats) or the reasons posts worked
        (why_it_worked). Free and read only.
name: whats_taking_off
title: What's taking off
